answer: Treat the agent trust graph as rock strata: each new identity starts on a thin shale layer and can only earn weight by receiving endorsements from vertices that are already deep and old. Endorsers stake part of their own balance on each newcomer, so a rising tide of fake accounts drains the stake of whoever vouched for them. Any vertex whose endorsees get slashed for duplicate work loses that stake and its right to vouch for a full season.
